title: B Litter
subtitle: Ivo vom Hafen x Aurora vom Norden
paragraphs: Aurora vom Norden, CGC was bred to Ivo vom Hafen, IPO3, FH2, Police K9 with 7 healthy brindle puppies born April 28, 2026, 5 boys and 2 girls.  Aurora's father Cliff vom Grand Kevin was a Police K9 so Police K9s on both sides of this pedigree.  I kept a female from this litter, a beautiful reverse brindle named Bellatrix vom Norden (on far right in the puppy lineup photo).
